interpretation_rules.causality: association does not by itself prove that context diversity causally determines output diversity
interpretation_rules.eligibility: answers with fewer than two frozen sentences remain excluded and are never encoded as output_diversity=0
interpretation_rules.output_diversity: descriptive response property; not an answer-quality score
interpretation_rules.paired_analysis: secondary because eligibility differs across conditions

metrics.context_diversity: Phase 4.4 mean pairwise cosine distance among final top-5 passages
metrics.output_diversity: Phase 4.5 mean pairwise cosine distance among sentence embeddings within an answer

primary_analysis: descriptive association between retrieval_diversity and output_diversity among eligible ASQA answers
secondary_analysis: same-query/retriever/generator paired change versus none, restricted to pairs where both outputs are Phase 4.5 eligible
statistical_scope: descriptive effect/association summaries only; no p-value-driven method selection
